Remove moves the file into the dream's directory, if it is still at
--expect. It refuses MEMORY.md, and a file whose source citations no other
memory carries: merge them into the memory that keeps the fact first. Put
MEMORY.md again without its line afterwards.

Usage:
  agent dream memory remove <file> --expect VERSION [flags]

Examples:
  agent dream memory remove old_fact.md --expect 0a1b2c3d4e5f6071

Flags:
      --dir string      The memory directory (default: this project's)
      --expect string   The version you read
  -h, --help            help for remove

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
